message.content:
In North America, the hotel brands most commonly considered for projects with a **branded residences** component are **Four Seasons**, **Ritz-Carlton**, **St. Regis**, **Waldorf Astoria**, **Conrad**, and **Mandarin Oriental**.[1][4][5][9][11]

Broader North American branded-residence activity also commonly includes **Marriott**-affiliated flags such as **EDITION**, **JW Marriott**, **Park Hyatt**, **Andaz**, **Fairmont**, **Sofitel**, **Raffles**, **Kimpton**, and **InterContinental**; these appear in regional brand profiles and hotel-branded residence reports as active or growing participants.[2][3][9][10][16]

If you want the answer framed more narrowly for **luxury hotel brands only**, the strongest recurring names in the North American market are **Four Seasons**, **Ritz-Carlton**, **St. Regis**, **Waldorf Astoria**, and **Mandarin Oriental**.[1][4][11][17]
